limitations: Fresh native flow confirms Start/WASD/Space; kills/reward boundaries are configured full-runtime fixtures using actual common receiveHit/death, prepared inventory/velocities and deterministic RNG seed, not a complete natural combat run.
Actual NVIDIA ANGLE/WebGL1 rendering inspected. Headless Edge screenshots demonstrate representative growth/spitter/boss egg and equipped scout egg; full16-species visual matrix was not repeated.
400-reward fixture validates conservation and128 actor pooling, not a maximum-load FPS/CPU benchmark.
Mobile/touch, long-term balance, storage-quota failure and maximum-population performance not verified.

visualInspection.observed: Ground drop egg uses original species palette and shadow; growth is a warm gold seed, visibly distinct from cyan inner ammo and loose outer equipped egg. Pickup +growth/egg texts are compact. Equipped egg turn/stop stays outside inner ammo orbit.

byteNormalization.explanation: servedSha256 preserves the exact browser-served bytes; sha256 identifies Git-canonical committed bytes. The only differing module is drops.js, normalized by existing .gitattributes. All JS tokens and behavior are identical.
